subject.title: Session `status` field values ("failed", "timeout", "done") mislead agents into spawning duplicate sessions

question: Should OpenClaw solve the misleading session-status problem by adding backward-compatible `resumable` metadata and guidance, by renaming/versioning the status values, or by scoping the hint to agent tool output only?
rationale: The source-reproducible bug is clear, but the durable fix changes model-visible session routing semantics and possibly the shared Gateway row contract.

options.title: Add resumability metadata and guidance
options.body: Expose a backward-compatible `resumable` signal where maintainers want the contract to live, and update model-facing wording/tests so agents prefer `sessions_send` for resumable ended rows.

options.title: Rename or version status values
options.body: Make the status names semantically precise, but require explicit compatibility/versioning work because the existing values are already shipped.

options.title: Keep the hint agent-only
options.body: Leave Gateway/client rows unchanged and add only model-facing sessions_list guidance if maintainers do not want to grow the shared row contract.

recommendation.title: Add resumability metadata and guidance
recommendation.body: Expose a backward-compatible `resumable` signal where maintainers want the contract to live, and update model-facing wording/tests so agents prefer `sessions_send` for resumable ended rows.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the session-list status/timing surface that would own most public-contract fallout from a status semantics change.
